transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Severus. The Longbottom family have written to the governors. The letter describes what they call — I quote — 'sustained cruelty' in your classroom. The governors will require a response from me, and I will require one from you. What happened?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: The Longbottoms? Oh, they're making a mountain out of a molehill, as usual. The boy in question was being disruptive and showing a flagrant disregard for the rules of the classroom. I merely corrected him in a manner I deemed appropriate.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Severus, I am aware of your high standards for discipline, as well as the unique challenges that come with teaching. However, accusations of "sustained cruelty" suggest there may have been more than a mere correction. Can you elaborate more specifically on what transpired so we can address their concerns appropriately?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: If I must, I will. The boy, Ned Longbottom, persisted in asking irrelevant questions and passing notes during an important lecture on the properties of mandrake roots. When I called him to task, he insolently challenged my authority. I then made it clear that such behavior would not be tolerated in my classroom. I fail to see how that constitutes 'cruelty', Dumbledore.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: While a teacher must maintain order, Severus, I must emphasize that our role also extends to nurturing the students' growth. Ned's actions, while disruptive, may reflect a need for guidance rather than strict discipline. I understand the frustrations such situations bring, but how can we ensure that a firm yet constructive approach is adopted in future instances to prevent similar misunderstandings?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Constructive? Guidance? Dumbledore, we are dealing with magical plants that can cause severe harm if misused. My methods are designed to instill respect for the subject and adherence to the necessary precautions. If you expect me to coddle my students like aPotion's'tincture, you are gravely mistaken. However, I will consider... alternative approaches if it will placate the governors.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: I appreciate your commitment to safety, Severus. The delicate balance we must maintain is to impress upon the students the seriousness of the subject while also fostering an environment where they feel supported in their learning journey. Perhaps involving Ned in a more active role could help redirect his energy positively. Would you be open to exploring such a possibility to address both safety and the governors' concerns?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Active role? It sounds like an unnecessary complication. However... if it will quiet the Longbottoms and the governors, I may allow Ned to assist in the care of the mandrake roots during class. This will provide him with a hands-on understanding of the plant's volatile nature. It is not, I must stress, a reward, but a means to demonstrate the importance of my instructions. I hope that suffices, Dumbledore.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: That sounds like a sensible approach, Severus. A practical involvement may indeed serve to both engage Ned constructively and convey the seriousness of Potions work. I trust your expertise will guide the situation to a resolution that satisfies all parties involved. If you encounter any further difficulties, please do not hesitate to reach out. Your commitment to teaching is valued, and I want to ensure you feel supported as well.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Your confidence in my ability to handle such matters is... appreciated. I will implement this... arrangement with Ned and monitor his progress. Should he continue to disrupt the class, I will not hesitate to take more stringent measures. Thank you for your... guidance, Dumbledore. I will report back if the situation does not improve.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: I am confident in your ability to handle the situation, Severus. Let us hope this new approach will encourage a positive change in Ned's behavior. Remember, the goal is to guide our students, even those who test our patience, toward a meaningful understanding of their lessons at Hogwarts. I appreciate your willingness to consider alternative methods, and I am here to support your efforts. Please keep me informed of any developments.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Guiding, is it? I will endeavor to... guide young Ned to a more appropriate behavior in my classroom. Should his... misguided enthusiasm persist, I will ensure that he understands the gravity of my subject. Your support is noted, Dumbledore. I will keep you abreast of any significant... developments. If there is nothing else, I have a Pensieve to grade.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Very well, Severus. Thank you for addressing this matter promptly. Let us see how the new arrangement unfolds. Should anything else arise, you know where to find me. Good luck with your Pensieve evaluations, and I'm sure your efforts will have a lasting impact. Do take care.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Impact, indeed. I will take the necessary precautions to ensure the continued safety and education of my students. Your... well wishes are... unnecessary. I will manage quite well, thank you. Good day, Dumbledore.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Good day, Severus. I trust you will manage effectively as always. Until next time.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Next time? I hope there is no next time, Dumbledore. I have a reputation to uphold, and I intend to do so. Wishing me a good day? How... touching. I bid you farewell.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Very well, Severus. Farewell.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Farewell, Dumbledore. May your day be free of... unnecessary interruptions. I have students to correct and lessons to plan. Good day to you.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: And to you, Severus. May your endeavors be fruitful and your day productive.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Productive? Indeed. I have no desire for any... fruitless endeavors. If you will excuse me, Headmaster, I have a surfeit of work to attend to. Good day.
